book.name: EFESUS
book.title: EFESUS Efesus mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Sine mafeŋ minbe
Tane Kuate tuku kiŋo kame nu tane tuku suŋgomba kume purte. Tane nu tuku maŋau ta te-purap.
Kristus nu sine tuku kume purmba sinenu ŋga nuŋe ŋgarosu kumam tuku pilna le atrau agaŋ mundur mayenu taŋaŋ Kuate tugum ambe kina. Tane taŋamba ndo kume pur maŋau mbolŋge minap.
Tane Kuate tuku mbal minig tukunu fare fare taŋgo pino ndoŋ une maŋau, wamdus kutur maŋau, agaŋ ndende kilam tuku piriride maŋau ta ŋakmba tane ŋgamukŋge mayok nda kuwaig.
Tane bukla pasa fare pasa fulaiŋ pasa ŋaigonu sa ndakap. Taŋgine miŋge ta Kuate gare pasa tumba minap.

Tane pasa te kila pile mayewap. Fare fare taŋgo pino ndoŋ unekade mbal, wamdus kutur ŋak mbal, agaŋ ndende kilam tuku piriride mbal nane Kuate le Kristus kulatkade ma mbol kine nda. Ande nu agaŋ ndende kilam tuku piririte ta nu Kuate idus ndamba nuŋe wamdus ta agaŋ ndende ta mbolŋge ndo minit.
Tane riroŋkap. Afuŋge naŋgine yabri pasa tambi tane mbar kame ta ke likap ŋga tane didikubekaig. Kuate tuku pasa pitaimba mbar taŋaŋ kade mbal Kuate tuku gubra nane mbolŋge minit.
Ta tuku tane nane ndoŋ ulendi ndakap.
Tane buk ma make tuku mbal minnaig. Kile tane Suŋgo ndoŋ ulendika tane mafeŋ tuku mbal minig. Tane mafeŋ tuku mbal minig taŋamba bulu mbolŋge likap.
Bulu mbolŋge likade mbal nane wam magenu tiŋreknu tugusek kile-mayokkade.
Wam ŋakmba pileŋga Suŋgo nu nzalite wam ta ndo kap.
Tane ma make tuku wam alo kugatok ta kasomŋge minmba taŋgine mine mayenu tambi nane tuku mbar kile-mayokkap.
Nane kuirka maŋau ŋaigonu kade ta tane ismba taŋgine taŋgine kubemba ise ndakap.
Wam kame ta buluŋge kilŋaniŋgit ta tugunu kilimok mayok kinig. Mayok kinig sulumba bulu mbolŋge minig.
Ta tuku ande nu teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Kinymba minit taŋgo ne aboŋga. Naŋe kumaknu maŋau kusrewa le Kristus nu ne kilŋanuwa ŋga sakate.

content: Tane kurau mayemba li mayenu mbolŋge minap. Tane wamdus kugatok mine ndaka wamdus kila mayenu ŋak minap.
Ait te ŋayo ait tukunu ait afu wam magenu ke likam tuku prode ta ake kusre ndakap.
Tane wamdus kugatok taŋaŋ mine ndaka Suŋgo tuku nzali kila palpe.
Tane kule kamenu nyumba ŋginŋganka maim maim maŋau ke ndakap. Taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal palpe le Tukul Guwa sinam kuwa le
David tuku mune, mune afu magenu, Tukul Guwa tuku mune ta ŋakmba taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu mune-munekap. Muŋgu mune-muneka wamdus sinamŋge Suŋgo tuku nyu te-duŋgap.
Tane mara mara siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus idusmba wam ŋakmba tuku Mam Kuate gare pasa tape.
Muŋgu kilnaig mbal tuku pasa
Kristus nu sine tuku Suŋgo ŋga tane taŋgine taŋgine pasa ismba kumnemŋge minap.
Pino kame, tane Suŋgo tuku miŋge kumnemŋge minig taŋamba ndo taŋgine taŋgo kumnemŋge minap.
Kristus nu nuŋe kuasmbi tuku gabat minit. Taŋamba ndo taŋgo kat taŋgine tane tuku gabat minig. Kristus tuku kuasmbi ta nu tuku ŋgarosu. Nuŋe ŋgarosu ta nu muskil kile-tidiŋgina.
Kristus tuku kuasmbi nane nu kumnemŋge minig taŋamba ndo pino kame tane wam ŋakmba mbolŋge taŋgine taŋgo kumnemŋge minap.
Taŋgo kame, Kristus nu nuŋe kuasmbi tuku suŋgomba kume purmba nuŋe ŋgarosu kumam tuku pilna taŋamba ndo tane taŋgine pino tuku suŋgomba kume purkap.
Kulembi ŋgaro minyaŋgade taŋaŋ nu nuŋe pasambi nane Kuate tuku mbal purfeŋnu kile-mayokkina.
Nuŋe kuasmbi ta mbar kugatok purfeŋnu maditaknu nu ndoŋ minwaig ŋga nu kumna.
Taŋamba ndo taŋgo kame taŋgine ŋgarosu tuku kume purde taŋamba taŋgine pino tuku kume purkap. Ne naŋe pino tuku kume purte ta ne naŋe ŋgarosu tuku turmba taŋate.
Taŋgo nu nuŋe ŋgarosu kasur ndate. Kuga. Nu nuŋe ŋgarosu kulat mayemba saŋgri pilete. Taŋamba ndo sine Kristus tuku ŋgarosu inum inumnu mineg tukunu nu sine nuŋe kuasmbi kulat mayete.
Kuyar pasa teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Taŋgo nu ina mam nuŋe kusreka piyo nuŋe ndoŋ muŋgu kile-deŋga minwaik. Nale ŋgarosu ndindo mayok kaŋgaik ŋga sakate. Mulum Pasa 2.24

content: Kuyar pasa te alonu suŋgo kuirok minit le kamuset ta teŋenmba. Kristus nu nuŋe kuasmbi ndoŋ tuku sakate.

Pasa ta tane muŋgu kilig wam ta tuku mata sakate. Ta tuku taŋgo kame, tane taŋgine ŋgarosu tuku kume purde taŋamba ndo taŋgine pino tuku kume purkap. Pino kame, tane taŋgine taŋgo tuku nyu idusniŋmba nane kumnemŋge minap.
